in_marathi.name: Athishta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athishta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Athishta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Athishta' which means 'Non-decaying' or 'Everlasting'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring longevity, prosperity, and success to the bearer.
